svg.text: 1. Pi + heatsink + paste + fan in the case; boot and update.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. i2cdetect -y 1 must show 0x53 before anything else.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Breadboard U2/U3/U4 with 100 nF each. Verify 3.3 V at every VCC.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Ice-point test 0 C; the open-TC flag must read 0 before you trust T.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. Bolt the sensor stack: magnet / M3 / nylon / PCB / nylon / nut.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6. Cable glands + heat-shrink, strain-relief, then close the lid.
